MEMORANDUM ON THE BLUE SHIRT SOCIETY

General survey of the Blue Shirt Society
adopted by this group of men for their organization.
Following the establishment of the National
Government in Nanking under the sponsorship of
the Chinese Kuomintang in 1927 after the successful
conclusion of the Northern Campaign of the Nationalist
Army under the supreme command of General Chiang
Kai-shek, national unity was in sight. However,
as a result of the vigorous purge of communist
elements among the Kuomintang members which commenced
on April 12, 1927 and which gave rise to a ten-year
struggle between the Kuomintang and the Communist
Party in China, a feeling of indignation among the
communists and their sympathisers was generated and
was principally directed against General Chiang Kai-
shek who was responsible for initiating the purge.
During the following years, while directing state
affairs in his capacity as Chairman of the National
Government, General Chiang Kai-shek had always felt
the necessity of taking effective measures in dealing
with those who, either prompted by political ambition
or motivated by personal ill-feeling, had persistently
but unsuccessfully challenged the authority of the
Kuomintang as the sole ruling authority of China.
After many years of quiet and preliminary pre-
paration and planning, a new secret body was founded
in almost all of the big cities and
on the suggestion of one named Hsu Chi

关于蓝衣社的备忘录

蓝衣社概况
这群人采用此名称作为其组织名称。
1927年，在蒋介石将军最高指挥下，国民革命军北伐胜利结束后，在中国国民党的支持下，南京国民政府成立，国家统一在望。然而，由于1927年4月12日开始的对国民党成员中共产党分子的严厉清洗，导致国民党与中国共产党在中国进行了十年的斗争，这在共产党及其同情者中产生了愤怒情绪，并主要针对负责发起清洗的蒋介石将军。
在随后的几年里，蒋介石将军以国民政府主席的身份主持国务时，始终感到有必要采取有效措施，对付那些出于政治野心或个人恩怨，持续但未成功地挑战国民党作为中国唯一统治当局权威的人。
经过多年安静的初步准备和策划，在几乎所有大城市都建立了一个新的秘密团体，这是在一位名叫徐继（Hsu Chi，音译）

中国，由蒋介石将军的一些坚定支持者组成。这群人没有为其组织正式采用任何头衔，但鉴于其在组织和运作方面与意大利的“黑衫党”相似，公众自动为其采用了“蓝衣社”的称号，尽管国民党或其任何领导人都强烈否认其存在。从一个 modest 的开始，这群人很快在中国大多数省份的政府官员和中国军队士兵中变得极具影响力。
这群人的活动与苏联的国家政治保卫总局（GPU）或纳粹德国的盖世太保（Gestapo）相似，如果不说完全相同的话。在这种秘密组织的存在广为人知后的许多年里，中国的文职官员和军官都有充分理由觉得他们到处都受到该秘密组织某些特工的监视，该组织被禁止承认其情报、政治和军事安全对蒋介石委员长巩固和加强其在这个国家的影响力至关重要；直到1937年中日战争爆发前，无论该组织在几乎每个领域活跃，任何人都无法逃脱有组织的可能性，对于该社团以外的人来说是不可能的

position as the Strong Man in Chinese politics.

Organization of the Blue Shirt Society

To avoid dissension among the followers of
General Chiang, it was arranged that this new
Society, instead of being independent, became part
of the Kuomintang, that is a party within a party.

Its method of organization was based on the
cell system, same as that adopted by the Communists.

The object of the Blue Shirt Society was,
briefly stated, to conduct secret service activities
against individuals and organizations opposing to
the alleged dictatorial authority of General Chiang
Kai-shek and his administration, particularly the
Communist Party in China.

Throughout the more than seven years' existence
of the Blue Shirt Society, little details of its
activities ever came to light which was due principally
to the stern disciplinary measures in force among
the members of the Society, who were forbidden to
admit to outsiders that they were members of the Blue
Shirt Society or to disclose its secrets under the
penalty of death, which was the only punishment.

As was to be expected, admission to membership
of the Blue Shirt Society was most difficult and only
Kuomintang members whose unflinching loyalty and
allegiance had been proved beyond the shadow of a
doubt were admitted into the organization.

The promoters and leaders of the Society con-

作为中国政坛强人的地位。

蓝衣社的组织

为了避免蒋介石追随者之间的分歧，安排这个新社团不是独立的，而是成为国民党的一部分，即党中之党。

其组织方法基于细胞系统，与共产党采用的相同。

简而言之，蓝衣社的目标是针对反对蒋介石将军及其政府所谓独裁权威的个人和组织进行秘密服务活动，特别是针对中国的共产党。

在蓝衣社存在的七年多时间里，其活动的细节很少曝光，这主要是由于社团成员中执行的严厉纪律措施，他们被禁止向外人承认自己是蓝衣社成员或泄露其秘密，违者处以死刑，这是唯一的惩罚。

正如预期的那样，加入蓝衣社非常困难，只有那些忠诚和效忠毫无疑问得到证明的国民党成员才被允许加入该组织。

该社团的发起人和领导人包

were successfully and continuously breaking through
loopholes in the net of government espionage and
filtering into almost every walk of life in Shanghai.
Alarmed by their activities, the Blue Shirt Society
despatched to Shanghai the late Mr. Woo Shing Yah
(吳醒亞), promoter of the Blue Shirt Society,
to take up the post of Chief of the Bureau of Social
Affairs of the Shanghai City Government and con-
currently Chairman of the Executive Committee of
the Shanghai Kuomintang Headquarters, which post
he successively held until his death in 1936.

On instructions from Nanking, Woo Shing Yah
established the "Li Zoe" (The Chinese Youth Strength
Society) (中國青年力社) in Shanghai which was
in reality a Shanghai counterpart of the Blue Shirt
Society conducting secret service work in this city.

With a view to successfully suppressing the
local communist influence, two sister organs of
the "Chinese Youth Strength Society" were at the
same time established by the Blue Shirt Society
under the sponsorship of Woo Shing Yah, viz:-

(1) The Middle Vanguard Society (中鋒社)
the mission of which was to supervise
student activities in local middle
schools.

(2) The Shanghai Municipality Mutual Aid
Society (上海市互助社), the mission
of which was to direct movements of
youths among local Kuomintang members.

Preliminary preparations having been completed
in the form of the establishment of the three

成功且不断地突破政府间谍网的漏洞，
渗透到上海几乎所有的行业。
蓝衣社对他们的活动感到震惊，派遣
已故的吴醒亚先生（蓝衣社发起人）前往上海，
担任上海市政府社会局局长，并兼任
上海国民党总部执行委员会主席，他相继
担任这些职务直至1936年去世。

根据南京的指示，吴醒亚
在上海建立了“力社”（中国青年力社），
这实际上是蓝衣社在上海的对应机构，
在本市从事秘密服务工作。

为了成功压制当地的共产主义影响，
蓝衣社在吴醒亚的支持下，同时建立了
“中国青年力社”的两个姊妹机构，即：

(1) 中锋社，
其任务是监督当地中学的学生活动。

(2) 上海市互助社，
其任务是指导当地国民党成员中的青年运动。

前期准备工作以这三个机构的建立形式完成

pages.en:

secret service organizations above-mentioned,
the Blue Shirt Society began to exercise control
of, and gain a foothold in, the local educational
circles, the press and other public organizations
by installing instructors in schools and universities,
editors and associate editors in newspaper offices,
and secretaries in public bodies. In this
connection, the Blue Shirt Society was successful
in gaining an upper hand in its struggle against
local communist influence.

Following the death of Woo Shing Yah in August
1936, the Chinese Youth Strength Society was dissolved
while the other two organizations definitely ceased
to exist in Shanghai at the end of 1937, in conse-
quence of the withdrawal of the Chinese armed forces
from the Shanghai area.

In dealing with the activities in Shanghai of
the Blue Shirt Society in general, mention may be
made of the general opinion that members of the
Special Service Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety
(later changed to Police Bureau) of the Shanghai City
Government were regarded as agents of the Blue Shirt
Society and many arrests of importance to the suppression
of communism were made by the staff of that Branch
between 1932 and 1936. Cases of kidnapping and
assassination of notable communists in the International
Settlement and the French Concession also came to
light.
pages.zh:

上述秘密组织，蓝衣社开始通过在学校和大学安插教员、在报馆安插编辑和副编辑、以及在公共团体安插秘书等方式，对当地教育界、新闻界及其他公共组织行使控制并站稳脚跟。在这方面，蓝衣社在对抗当地共产主义影响的斗争中成功地占据了上风。

1936年8月吴醒亚死后，中国青年力社解散，而另外两个组织也随着中国军队撤出上海地区，于1937年底在上海确已不复存在。

在谈及蓝衣社在上海的一般活动时，值得一提的是普遍的看法，即上海市政府公安局（后改为警察局）特务处的成员被视为蓝衣社的特工，该处人员在1932年至1936年间实施了许多对镇压共产主义具有重要意义的逮捕行动。在国际租界和法租界绑架和刺杀著名共产党人的案件也相继曝光。

pages.en:

During this period, one of the most outstanding
attacks by the Blue Shirts upon the "Left" was the
disappearance of Miss Ting Ling (丁玲), a
well-known Leftist writer, and her paramour named
Manu Feng, who, it was believed, were abducted
from No. 7, Quinsan Gardens, off North Szechuen
Road, on May 14, 1933 by Ma Shao Wu (馬紹武),
a communist renegade, then connected with the
Bureau of Public Safety and engaged in communist
suppression work.

This abduction was publicly denounced by Mr.
Yang Ang-vuh (楊杏佛), alias Yang Chien (楊銓),
veteran Kuomintang leader, who was known to enter-
tain sympathies towards the communists. Yang's
open denunciation however soon led to his assassination
in the French Concession, believed to be at the hands
of Blue Shirt agents.

As a retaliation, Ma Shao Wu and his successor
Wong Yung Hwa (王永華) were respectively assassinated
in the Settlement by emissaries of the Chinese
Communist Party. Their deaths, no doubt, meant
a severe blow to the activities of the Blue Shirt
Society in Shanghai.

Another person of prominence among the local
Chinese community was assassinated during this time
in the person of Mr. Sz Liang Tsai (史量才),
Proprietor of the Shun Pao, who was alleged to have
refused to accede to the request of the Blue Shirt
pages.zh:
- 8 -

在此期间，蓝衣社对“左派”最突出的攻击之一是著名左翼作家丁玲女士及其情夫冯达（Manu Feng，音译）的失踪。据信，他们于1933年5月14日在北四川路昆山路花园7号被马绍武绑架。马绍武是一名共产党叛徒，当时隶属于公安局，从事镇压共产主义的工作。

此次绑架事件遭到国民党元老杨杏佛先生（又名杨铨）的公开谴责，众所周知，他对共产党人抱有同情态度。然而，杨的公开谴责很快导致他在法租界被刺杀，据信是蓝衣社特工所为。

作为报复，马绍武及其继任者王永华分别在上海公共租界被中国共产党派遣的人员刺杀。他们的死亡无疑对蓝衣社在上海的活动造成了沉重打击。

在此期间，当地华人社区中另一位显要人物也被刺杀，此人即《申报》业主史量才先生。据称，他因拒绝答应蓝衣社

Society for installing its members in the news-
paper office.

Present situation and conclusion

The Blue Shirt Society has been inactive,
not only in Shanghai, but in China as a whole, since
early 1938. General Chiang Kai-shek had in
1938 caused the establishment of an organization
under the title of "The San Min Chu I Youth Group"
(三民主義青年團) which is an independent organ
but nominally under the Kuomintang with General Chiang
as its head. The purpose of this organization
is to promote good citizenship to supplement the New
Life Movement, of which he is the sponsor. The
important work of the Group consists of the pro-
motion of civil service, collection of intelligence
and the guarding against political thoughts opposing

自1938年初以来，蓝衣社不仅在上海，而且在整个中国都处于不活动状态。蒋介石将军曾于1938年促成建立了一个名为“三民主义青年团”的组织，这是一个独立的机构，但名义上隶属于国民党，由蒋介石将军担任首领。该组织的目的是促进良好公民意识，以补充由其发起的新生活运动。该团的重要工作包括推广公务、收集情报以及防范反对三民主义的政治思想。

Made by C.D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

During 1935, the following three organizations came into existence in Shanghai under the sponsorship of Wu Shing Yah (吳醒亞), then Chief of the Bureau of Social Affairs and the local Tangpu :-

1. The Chinese Youth Strength Society (上海青年社), directed political activity among students in local universities on behalf of the local Tangpu.

2. The Middle Vanguard Society (中鋒社), supervised student activities in local middle schools.

3. The Shanghai Municipality Mutual Aid Society (上海市互助社), directed movements of the youths among local Kuomintang members.

The authority of administering these organizations was vested in the executive members of the local Tangpu who, in the execution of their duties, worked hand in glove with the leading members of the local branch of the Blue shirt Society.

While the Chinese Youth Strength Society (1) was dissolved following the death of Wu Shing Yah in August, 1936, who was concurrently director of the Society, the other two organizations, it is known, definitely ceased to exist in Shanghai at the end of 1937, in consequence of the withdrawal of the Chinese armed forces from the Shanghai Area.

The "Blue Shirt Society" was established in
1931 with a view to achieving an effective "Party
Rule" and was sponsored by Chiang Kai-shek with a
number of his most ardent supporters. This
Society was a secret organization and only operated
within the Kuomintang, its main object being to create
a "strong Kuomintang feeling among the rank and file
in the Army". When this was accomplished the
warlords and their abuse of military power would be
defeated.

The Society eventually became very powerful
in most of the Provinces of China and caused most of
the militarists to swear anew their allegiance to
the National Government and to obey the Kuomintang.

Branches were established in Shanghai, Nanking,
Hankow and Canton and in some instances the society
members were known to have removed political and
military opponents of the Kuomintang.

The Society was most active in Shanghai under
the leadership of Wu Shing Yah (吴醒亚), Chief of
the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai City
Government but from 1932 to 1934/lapsed after that and
lost its chief through death on August 1936. Pan
Kung Chan, then Deputy to Wu Shing Yah, became Chief
of the Society but did nothing to further its
activities and nothing was heard of the society until
early in 1938 when Pan Kung Chan and most of his
followers departed for Chungking, where he had been
ordered to proceed by the Government.

“蓝衣社”成立于1931年，旨在实现有效的“党治”，由蒋介石及其一些最热情的支持者发起。该社是一个秘密组织，仅在国民党内运作，其主要目标是在军队基层官兵中营造“强烈的国民党意识”。一旦实现这一目标，军阀及其对军事权力的滥用将被击败。

该社最终在中国大多数省份变得非常强大，促使大多数军事将领重新宣誓效忠国民政府并服从国民党。

在上海、南京、汉口和广州设立了分支机构，在某些情况下，已知该社成员清除了国民党的政治和军事对手。

该社在上海最为活跃，由上海市政府社会局局长吴醒亚领导，但从1932年到1934年[原文此处有脱漏或中断]，此后逐渐停滞，并于1936年8月因首领去世而失去领导。潘公展当时是吴醒亚的副手，成为该社首领，但未采取任何措施推进其活动，直到1938年初潘公展及其大多数追随者奉政府命令前往重庆之前，再未听到有关该社的消息。
